decisions.statement: The game names no way to list its items.
Every item id is tried in turn.
Mining runs in batches so the game stays playable.
Mining that has run past the stated misses is complete.
What mining takes lands in the saved variables rather than over the wire.
Mining survives a reload of the interface.
The game writes saved variables only as the client shuts down.

definition: the addon taking the game's own item and quest data one id at a time
